description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Panasonic Avionics Corporation develops inflight entertainment and connectivity products for aircraft. The Software Engineer will develop and support software applications and automation tools for configuring, testing, validating, and troubleshooting networks of embedded systems, while diagnosing Linux, networking, and hardware-interaction issues. The role also involves cross-disciplinary collaboration, technical documentation, and applying new technologies to engineering, manufacturing, and field operations.
Embedded Linux software engineer developing automation tools and troubleshooting networked hardware systems

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, and maintain software applications and automation tools used to support engineering, manufacturing, and field operations
• Troubleshoot software, Linux, networking, and hardware-interaction issues with support from experienced team members
• Work with embedded devices, networked equipment, and hardware peripherals
• Collaborate with engineers across multiple disciplines to solve challenging technical problems
• Create clear and effective technical documentation, troubleshooting guides, and deployment procedures
• Continuously learn new technologies and apply them to real-world problems

Requirements:
• Experience with one or more programming languages
• Understanding of basic software design and object-oriented programming principles
• Git and modern source-control practices (GitLab, CI/CD pipelines, code reviews)
• Familiarity with application development on Linux platforms
• Understanding of Linux operations and basic operating-system fundamentals
• Basic understanding of publish/subscribe architectures
• Understanding of TCP/IP fundamentals and basic familiarity with DHCP, routing, switching, bridges, and VLANs
• Exposure to embedded Linux development
• Basic understanding of basic hardware components, block diagrams, and schematics
• Accurate, thorough, and clear technical documentation
• Strong written and verbal communication
• Ability to work collaboratively
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
• 0-3 years of proven experience in software engineering with demonstrated depth in Linux systems and software development
• Relevant experience may include internships, coursework, research, open-source contributions, or personal projects
• All candidates must have valid authorization to work in the U.S

Preferred:
• C/C++ preferred
• Exposure to Android application development
• Exposure to virtualization and container technologies such as KVM, libvirt, and Docker
• Exposure to computer vision technologies such as vision models, machine learning, and image processing
• Familiarity with network diagnostic tools such as tcpdump or Wireshark
• Experience in several of the areas above is desired
• Experience with machine learning or AI-assisted tooling
